summary: product Opus 5.5 review complete and reconciled; supported findings and qualifications recorded in final review and phase plan.
evidence: product/run.json: successful subscription-only run and reported model usage
limitations: Packet-only, read-only review. No tests, build, browser or server were run; every finding is inferred from source. The lead's 214 passed / 2 skipped figure was not independently verified.
Server routes (app.ts), VisuaService, storage and auth middleware were not in the packet. Statements that the server refuses an action rest on the documentation and on packages/core/src/access.ts.
Whether workspace ids differ from slugs is not visible in the packet; the SSE query-key finding depends on that.
Whether the default SOC 2 skeleton carries pointsOfFocus is not visible; the note that PBC requests may be empty in a fresh clone is an inference from README and architecture wording.
Separation-of-duties rules (an author accepting their own evidence or approving their own policy) could not be checked without the service code.
Visual quality, contrast as rendered, real GPU performance, and label layout were not observed. Responsiveness comments come from the CSS and the e2e expectations.
Agent runtime, offline playbooks, corpus licensing, tenancy, SSO and the audit-chain implementation belong to other lanes and were touched only where they surface in the UI.
State-law dates and counts were reviewed as code behaviour, not as current law.
